coder_notes: Lymphopenic (ALC <=1x10^9/L) newly diagnosed GBM after CCRT, randomised TJ107 vs placebo during adjuvant temozolomide. TJ107 coded supportive (lymphocyte recovery is the only registered outcome; no antitumour hypothesis stated) and flagged uncertain because this decides S6. If TJ107 is judged a candidate, regimen would be combination (with adjuvant temozolomide) and the ALC outcome would be a blood pharmacodynamic measure (target_engagement yes). Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but every patient receives adjuvant TMZ (outcome refers to pre-dose 3rd TMZ), so listed as soc_backbone. Placebo not listed as an agent. ALC is not a tumour biomarker.
